hard_rules: No classifier threshold, provider density, sample seed, sample count or acceptance threshold may change after first C6b execution.
C6b passes only if both precommitted blocker classes pass independently.
Rows outside the classifier are fail-closed outside the candidate LayeredMFP core envelope; they are not solver failures.
A C6b failure does not license promotion of the 113-node provider on the same revealed holdout.

holdout.filtering: Only rows inside the fixed provider head envelope are formed; the frozen classifier is then applied before accuracy aggregation. Rejected rows are counted but cannot affect qualification metrics.

scope_limit: Hydraulic homogeneous-face representation only. No transient, root uptake, drainage, groundwater coupling, MODFLOW, response tangent or production admission.
